---
title: "Goals, Non-goals, and Upstream Relationship"
---

## Goals

SCGSim is an independent downstream toolkit for research-stable,
superconducting-circuit simulation workflows. Its direction is:

- one explicit geometry-to-results contract across supported solvers;
- public, reviewable provenance and failure behavior;
- notebook-first workflows that stay readable to researchers;
- results-first feedback to the [gsim community](https://github.com/gdsfactory/gsim)
  through public fixtures and evidence;
- Agent-driven development with exact revision and validation records.

## Non-goals

SCGSim does not:

- claim to be official gsim or replace upstream gsim;
- promise that every code change receives Human review;
- automatically accept upstream gsim APIs as SCGSim APIs;
- maintain compatibility shims for older experimental interfaces;
- support Meep;
- use external gdsfactory or cloud execution as a fallback;
- publish private designs, controls, paths, or run artifacts.

## Starting-source identities

The integrated starting lane is:

| Authority | Exact identity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| gsim downstream source | `0.2.0+scq.1`, `main@8f5dc6c05255d003a9c6d8959537bcf8068379d3`, tree `505a53741953666da17d81b7036eba3ac296cd1a` | Source input for selective downstream integration; not automatic SCGSim API acceptance. |
| Semantic Geometry Builder | `e74a343154c6b19b6ba32d6fb297e700cfe08ff2` | Geometry and topology authority consumed by SCGSim. |

These identities establish provenance only. They imply neither a numerical
Surface-EPR result nor a live Palace solve.

## Upstream feedback

The default feedback route is public fixtures, evidence, and concrete findings.
Upstream source contribution is optional and case-specific rather than the
definition of downstream success.
